validate_task_spec.goal: The poll package can save the last-seen cursor to a file in a caller-given data directory, load it back, and tell whether a topic is one of the fixed topics.
acceptance_criteria: Saving the cursor "abc" to a data directory and then loading from that same directory returns "abc" and no error.
Loading from a data directory where no cursor was saved returns "" and no error.
IsKnownTopic("orders") returns true when "orders" is in Topics, and IsKnownTopic returns false for a topic that is not in Topics.
non_goals: No change to the poller: a later task calls these helpers.
validate_task_spec.context: The cursor lives in a single file named cursor under the data directory the caller passes. Topics is the fixed []string declared in topics.go.

validate_completion.summary: Two functions over a fixed file name, and slices.Contains for the topic check.
validate_completion.final_diff:
diff --git a/internal/poll/cursor.go b/internal/poll/cursor.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/poll/cursor.go
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+package poll
+
+import (
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"slices"
+)
+
+const cursorFile = "cursor"
+
+func SaveCursor(dir, cursor string) error {
+	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, cursorFile), []byte(cursor), 0o600)
+}
+
+// LoadCursor returns "" on a fresh install: a missing file is not an error.
+func LoadCursor(dir string) (string, error) {
+	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, cursorFile))
+	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
+		return "", nil
+	}
+	return string(b), err
+}
+
+func IsKnownTopic(topic string) bool {
+	return slices.Contains(Topics, topic)
+}
